title: finding(skills): PM-side review texts still teach the skip-changeset label unconditionally — the same cross-repo false mechanism just fixed in the dev contract
body:
Filed unassigned by the dev seat working the os-dev contract-fix bundle (session `session_017TNzEetykdh7ceZGwuAPLq`, PR #8969) — recording only, out of that bundle's declared file surface (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` only).

## The residue

#8915 fixed the dev-side instruction: os-dev.md now makes the `skip-changeset` step repo-conditional (this repo: real mechanism, apply + read back; objectui: the label does not exist — empty-frontmatter changeset is the tests/docs-only declaration, never create the label there). But the **PM-side** instruction surface still carries the unconditional form in two places:

1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, the review-checklist clause: 「tests/docs-only 走`skip-changeset` 标签」 (unconditional).
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md`, scope-check bullet: 「Tests/docs-only PR 走 `skip-changeset` 标签，不走空 changeset（空 changeset 滞留发布）」 — doubly inverted for objectui, where the empty changeset is the *correct* declaration and the label is a false mechanism; the 「空 changeset 滞留发布」 parenthetical is a this-repo fact presented as universal.

A PM seat reviewing an objectui PR by these texts would demand a label the repo does not define (minting it on first application — the exact hazard measured three times in one day on the dev side) and/or reject the correct empty-frontmatter changeset as a defect. Verified against objectui origin/main while implementing the bundle: zero `skip-changeset` hits in its workflows; its changeset-presence workflow states "An empty frontmatter counts".

## Suggested shape (for the skills seat to grade)

Mirror the dev-side fix: make both PM-side clauses repo-conditional in the same terms os-dev.md now uses, keeping the this-repo mechanics (whole-set PUT, read-back closes the step, first-run race) intact. House constraints apply: ratchet ceilings on both files (headroom 0 — fund by compression), id-lint, frame-sync anchors in SKILL.md.

Relates to #8915 (dev-side half, fixed by PR #8969). #8915 is not re-opened by this card; the PM-side files were explicitly outside that bundle's file surface.
